# ADR-001

This file lives under `docs/`, the same overlapping path as
`ambiguous.md`. Its `id: ADR-001` resolves the conflict — under
ADR-007 § DOC-007, the id-claim wins when its namespace matches one
of the conflicting namespaces. The file is classified as ADR with
no `cfg.path-conflict` message.
